mapper.select: SELECT pd.product_detail_code, pd.category_code, pd.product_no, pd.loginID, pd.order_date, pd.rental_date, pd.return_date, pd.order_reason AS return_reason, pd.product_state, pd.approve, ui.name AS user_name, ui.regdate AS apply_date FROM tb_product_detail pd LEFT JOIN tb_userinfo ui ON pd.loginID = ui.loginID WHERE pd.product_detail_code = #{product_detail_code} AND pd.category_code = #{category_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_product_detail SET product_state = 'R' WHERE product_state='Y' AND loginID = #{loginId}

/*kr.happyjob.study.repository.returns.ReturnsMapper.returnOne*/ UPDATE tb_product_detail SET product_state = 'R' /* 상태를 'R'(반납 신청 중)으로 변경 */ WHERE product_detail_code = #{productDetailCode} /* 특정 장비 코드만 */ AND loginID = #{loginId} AND product_state = 'Y' /* 현재 'Y'(사용 중)인 장비만 허용 */
